policies.fit: same monthly deadline-clock wait0 training IDs, sorted approval/order-ID rows and train-only preprocessing as the corresponding frozen backbone
policies.historical_scores: each historical month uses its own monthly model; never final-model rescores of training rows
policies.ranking: uncalibrated score descending then order_id ascending; threshold zero, fill daily floor(10% * complete eligible scored batch)
policies.label_maturity: historical validation outcomes strictly before E; unknown labels still compete for full-batch slots
policies.selection: maximize worst recall of three known-label historical months, then pooled TP, pooled raw AP, fixed candidate order
policies.floor: 30% each historical month is a diagnostic suitability gate; no future recall guarantee
policies.search: nine fixed cells: Logistic load C1/C.01 and XGBoost geo crossed with 7d/14d/combined overdue backlog changes; backbone parameters unchanged; no adaptive grid or E early stopping
policies.comparison: delivery_wait0 versus deadline_wait0 isolates training maturity clock at fixed model/wait; deadline_wait0 versus deadline_wait30 changes training approval wait; old 60-day models provide background only
policies.features: 7d or14d adds9 numeric overdue backlog features; combined adds18; no new categorical interactions, arrival features, target encoding or dispatch
policies.probabilities: classifier scores uncalibrated; ranker sigmoid is a monotone numerical interface conversion, not probability calibration; reject saturation that collapses distinct margins
policies.evaluation_role: all E months and design have been informed by repeatedly inspected development results; pre-fit specification does not make these periods independent tests
policies.coverage: eligible valid eventually-delivered cohort only; not every originally approved order
policies.batch_timing: complete closed calendar-day batches required; up to one day wait; no per-order online cap guarantee
policies.promotion: new artifacts remain research only; original and prior research models preserved
policies.visualization: no dashboard or new plots in this experiment; user requested ranking work first
policies.pending_limit: no cancellation timestamp available; approved cancelled orders can remain pending inside the 30/90-day windows; static master-table location assumption
policies.ranker: fixed backbone classifiers; old56 candidates are verified/replayed and never refit; no new calibration or threshold
policies.training_clock: delivery clock is actual delivery; deadline clock is min(actual delivery, midnight after promised calendar date); original actual-delivery metadata and history unchanged
policies.clock_limit: eventual-delivery cohort remains retrospectively selected; no cancellation outcome labels inferred; assumes original promise date and immediate delivery event availability
policies.paired_comparison: baseline versus each fixed lag package; 7d/14d/combined hold identical training IDs, row order and estimator parameters
policies.geolocation: seventh file treated as static postal reference available at approval; paired-valid-coordinate per-ZIP median, great-circle distance not road distance; no as-of version metadata or result-based coordinate clipping
policies.dispatch_availability: no dispatch candidates reused or fitted in this round; frozen preceding sensitivity report retained
policies.primary_selection: previous56 plus new9; selectors previous_candidates, new_backlog, primary_without_dispatch; maximize worst of three historical month recalls then pooled TP/AP/fixed order
policies.solver: Logistic retains L2/lbfgs C1 or C.01/max_iter10000; reject ConvergenceWarning or n_iter >= max_iter; solver diagnostics never select models

feature_definition.raw_population: All raw valid purchase/approval orders with approval >= purchase, including cancelled/unfinished orders; final status and target never read.
feature_definition.snapshot: At s: approval in [s-90days,s), original promise calendar midnight+1day <= s, actual delivery missing or >= s. Delivery exactly s is still unknown; missing promise cannot establish overdue.
feature_definition.boundaries: Approval strictly before each snapshot, delivery strictly before it removes pending status; promise expiry and 90day lower approval boundary inclusive.
feature_definition.missing: Known groups without eligible overdue orders have count/growth/change0; unknown seller/route or missing query time stays missing; no unknown-key pooling.
feature_definition.current_count_check: Current B(t) independently recomputed and must equal each existing frozen pending_overdue_90d count on known query groups.
feature_definition.preprocessing: Corresponding frozen backbone parameters/rows/sort and train-only numeric median/indicators, Logistic StandardScaler and categorical most-frequent/OHE min_frequency20 unchanged.
feature_definition.availability: Assumes timely approval/delivery records, original promise, static states and primary seller/item information; no ingestion/revision timestamps. Geographic reference assumption unchanged for XGBoost.
feature_definition.limitations: No cancellation timestamps, so cancelled approvals may remain pending; moving90day window can reduce backlog by age-out rather than delivery. Eligible labels remain eventually-delivered retrospective cohort.
feature_definition.contrast: Each lag package added directly to original load65 or geo83 backbone; no arrival-trend/cross additions to new candidates, no new C/grid/calibration/threshold.
